user_prompt: We need to orchestrate the launch of our new product line, ensuring that procurement sources quality raw materials that meet our standards, engineering designs and validates the components, operations sets up manufacturing processes, and sales prepares go-to-market strategies. As we ramp up production, we'll also need to seamlessly integrate with our systems to retrieve and manage incoming customer orders and account information for processing. Additionally, the process should include coordinating any engineering modifications and material lifecycle changes across departments to keep everything synchronized. Can you help us design a workflow that handles all of these moving parts together?

The activity "Integrate with systems to retrieve customer orders" is asking for a capability to fetch order data from systems. However, none of the candidates provide this functionality. The candidates are all focused on marketing campaigns, customer engagement, contact state management, and campaign analytics—not on order retrieval or order management systems. While some candidates touch on "customer" and "engagement," they do not fulfill the core requirement of retrieving customer orders from integrated systems.
